fieldValues.title: Agent PRs collide and go stale, so the owner spends their time making work mergeable
fieldValues.statement: Agents finish work, but on srs and srs-rust their pull requests fall behind master, collide with each other's files, or duplicate each other, and nothing in the flow repairs that. I spend hours unpicking PRs so they can merge instead of directing the work, so the work does not really flow.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-28: vignette 913a3db6 (I've just spent two hours unpicking prs again)
